               <para>Clean the brake pads.</para>
               <proceduralStep>
                  <para>Find each of the brake pads.</para>
               </proceduralStep>
               <proceduralStep>
                  <para>Apply a thin layer of the <internalRef internalRefId="sup-0001" internalRefTargetType="irtt04" /> on each of the brake pads.</para>
